Title

2X-3KPR（トゥエックス）

Card Text

「夜間状態」の場合、同じ場所の自分の反乱軍、エイリアンは、すべて戦闘力が＋２される。「水耕ステーション」のカードと同じ場所にあると、さらに耐：損耗＜３を得る。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-2x-3kpr-tooex-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''整備点検用の単純作業ドロイド。各所に配備された警戒センサーや非常灯、電磁フェンスなどを遠隔起動させる。レリモア・ドロイズ社製のサーバント・ドロイド。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' 2X-3KPR (Tooex). '''Card text:''' During night conditions, all your Rebels and aliens at the same location are power +2. At the same location as [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]], it also gains immunity to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' A simple labor droid used for maintenance and inspection. It remotely activates warning sensors, emergency lights, electromagnetic fences, and similar equipment installed throughout an area. A servant droid manufactured by Lerrimore Droids.

Title

ベルー・ラーズ

Card Text

オーウェン・ラーズと同じ場所にいるか、水耕ステーションの上にいる場合、没収値に＋２。相手のターンに、ロストデッキへ行った場合、次の自分のターンが終了するまで、ルークの戦闘力に＋３。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-beru-lars-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''オーウェン・ラーズの妻。ルーク・スカイウォーカーの保護者。ルークの帝国アカデミー入学を夫のオーウェンに進言する。ファームの水耕ステーションの管理をしている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Beru Lars. '''Card text:''' Forfeit +2 when at the same location as [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]] or at [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]]. If she goes to the Lost Pile during your opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn. '''Lore:''' [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]]'s wife and [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]'s guardian. She urges her husband Owen to let Luke enter the Imperial Academy. She manages the farm's hydroponics station.

ビッグズ・ダークライター

操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。レッド３に乗れば、さらに回避が＋１され、戦闘運命値を引けない場合に、１枚だけ引ける。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-3o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

''ヤヴィンの戦いで、レッド３を操縦する。ルークの幼なじみ。ヘルメットのエンブレムは、ランド・エクリプティック号で反乱を起こし、造船所から盗み出したことの証。''

'''Title:''' Biggs Darklighter. '''Card text:''' A starship he pilots is power +2. If aboard Red 3, also maneuver +1, and he may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. '''Lore:''' Pilots Red 3 at the Battle of Yavin. Luke's childhood friend. The emblem on his helmet marks the mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic and its theft from the shipyards.

Title

ボシェック

Card Text

操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋3。密輸屋ではないが、ケッセル・ランを行える。耐：損耗<3。

Lore

モグリのパイロット。無資格の宇宙船技術者。モス・アイズリーに秘密研究室を持つ。ハン・ソロの持つケッセル・ランの記録を破った豪語した。オビ＝ワンに出会った後、改心する。

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' BoShek. '''Card text:''' Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. Although he is not a smuggler, he can make a Kessel Run. Immune to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' An unlicensed pilot. An unqualified starship technician. Has a secret laboratory in Mos Eisley. Boasted that he had broken Han Solo's Kessel Run record. Reformed after meeting Obi-Wan. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese explicitly says he is not a smuggler; the English says he may make a Kessel Run in place of a smuggler. The Japanese lore calls him an unlicensed pilot and an unqualified starship technician, rather than the English “Rogue pilot” and “Outlaw starship tech,” and shortens Obi-Wan Kenobi to Obi-Wan.[[:File:Premiere-L-boshek-decipher-archive.gif|BoShek original English printed face]].

Sources

* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97 (Japanese Premiere checklist).

Title

C-3PO（シースリーピーオー）

Card Text

Ｃ－３ＰＯのいる位置で、Ｃ－３ＰＯを含むドロイドと反乱軍のペアが一つ組めるごとに合計戦闘力＋２。同じ位置にいるＲ２－Ｄ２の没収値に＋２。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-c-3po-see-threepio-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''サイボット・ギャラクティカ社の３ＰＯは、人間と機械の通訳を務めるドロイドである。６００万種以上の言語に通じ、作動から１１２年が経過。一度もメモリ消去を受けたことがない…ただし、覚えている限りでの話だが。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' C-3PO (See-Threepio). '''Card text:''' At [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]]'s site, add 2 to total power for each pair consisting of a droid, including [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]], and a Rebel. [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)|R2-D2]] is forfeit +2 at the same site. '''Lore:''' Cybot Galactica's 3PO is a droid that interprets between humans and machines. It knows more than six million languages and has been operating for 112 years. It has never had its memory erased, at least as far as it can remember.

Title

Card Text

ＣＺ－３のいるロケーションか、そこに隣接した位置で、相手が戦闘、フォース消耗を宣言した場合、リアクションとしてそのロケーションにカードを配備できる。配備コストは通常通り支払う。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-cz-3-seezee-three-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

''サーヴォドロイド社製造のＣＺ通信ドロイド。旧型だが広く使われている。コムリンクを内蔵し、優れたスクランブラーと暗号化機能を持つ。''

'''Title:''' CZ-3 (Seezee-Three). '''Card text:''' When your opponent declares a battle or Force drain at CZ-3's location or an adjacent site, you may deploy cards to that location as a react. Pay the normal deployment costs. '''Lore:''' A CZ communications droid manufactured by Serv-O-Droid. An older model that remains widely used. It has a built-in comlink and sophisticated scrambling and encryption capabilities.

同じ位置で、相手のキャラクターが武器を起動した際、１フォース消費して、突起で攻撃することができる（１ターンに１回だけ）。対象を選んで運命数を引き、運命数＝能力値なら、命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-dice-ibegon-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Choose a target and draw destiny. The attack hits if destiny equals the target's ability. '''Lore:''' Lak Sivrak's drinking companion. A female Florn Lamproid, a hunter who injects poison into prey with a protruding appendage. She is attuned to the Force, with a reputation for being able to alter the flow of time.

Lore

''ジョン・「ダッチ」・ヴァンダー。ヤヴィンの戦いでゴールド中隊を指揮。愛機はＹウイング。元はレンフォーラ基地のスペクター中隊指揮官。ヘルメットにそのエンブレムがある。''

All other Gold Squadron pilots at the same site are forfeit +1. '''Lore:''' Jon “Dutch” Vander commanded Gold Squadron at the Battle of Yavin. He flies a Y-wing. Formerly commander of Specter Squadron at Renforra Base, whose emblem is on his helmet.

The Japanese game text repeats the phrase meaning “at the same site” twice in its final sentence.

A gambler and cheat.

Card Text

１回の戦闘に１度だけ、１フォース消費して、引いた運命数をキャンセルしてもう一度引きなおしてよい。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。宇宙船がミレニアム・ファルコンなら更に回避に＋２し、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に、１枚だけ引いてよい。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-han-solo-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

''密輸屋兼ギャンブラー。反乱軍の英雄。コレリア人の熟練パイロットで。ミレニアム・ファルコンの所有者。副操縦士のチューバッカは、彼に“命の借り”がある。賞金首。''

'''Title:''' Han Solo. '''Card text:''' Once per battle, you may use 1 Force to cancel a destiny just drawn and draw again. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If it is the Millennium Falcon, also add 2 to maneuver and draw one battle destiny if none can otherwise be drawn. '''Lore:''' A smuggler, gambler, and Rebel hero. A skilled Corellian pilot and owner of the Millennium Falcon. His co-pilot Chewbacca owes him a life debt. There is a bounty on his head.

Title

ジェック・ポーキンズ

Card Text

操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。レッド６を操縦していれば、さらに回避値が＋１され、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に１枚だけ引ける。

Lore

''ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド６を操縦する。掃射攻撃を得意とする。ティアフォン反乱軍前哨基地で、イエローエース中隊に属していた。元はベスティン星系の独立貿易商人。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Jek Porkins. '''Card text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Red 6, its maneuver is increased by 1 and he may draw one battle destiny if unable to draw one. '''Lore:''' Piloted Red 6 in the Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing attacks. Served in the Yellow Aces squadron at the Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Formerly an independent trader from the Bestine system. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore explicitly says he was formerly an independent trader. The English says he is a free trader from the Bestine system. The game text expresses the same listed bonuses in different wording.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Jek Porkins]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Title

カーベ

Card Text

自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置にいる相手の武器かアイテムを対象に選ぶ。運命数を引き、運命数＜対象の運命数ならば、盗んだことになる。アイテムならそのまま使え、武器ならば同じ位置にいる戦士に渡す（コスト０で配備する）ことができる。

Lore

''チャドラ・ファンの少女盗賊。マフタックが保護者。奴隷商人にタトゥイーンに捨てられた。ジュリ・ジュースが好物。モス・アイズリーのジャバ・ザ・ハットの別宅を荒らす。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Kabe. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, choose an opponent's weapon or item at the same location as a target. Draw destiny; if it is less than the target's destiny number, it is stolen. An item can be used as it is; a weapon can be handed to a warrior at the same location, deploying it at zero cost. '''Lore:''' A young Chadra-Fan thief whose guardian is Muftak. Abandoned on Tatooine by slavers. Fond of juri juice. Robs Jabba the Hutt's residence in Mos Eisley. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to an opponent's weapon or item at the same location; the English names a weapon or device at the same site. The Japanese lore says Kabe robs Jabba's residence; the English says she once robbed it.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Kabe]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

カルファルニル・シンドロス

Card Text

カルのいるロケーションで戦闘が起こって、両方のプレイヤーが１枚ずつ戦闘運命数を求めた場合、自分の運命数が大きければ、相手の運命数は０になる。移動速度３。操縦する大型艦の戦力に＋２。脚が長すぎて、宇宙戦闘機や密閉型のビークルには乗れない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-kal-falnl-c-ndros-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''哺乳原類風の飛行種族、クオサヴのメス。身長３.５メートル。過保護な母親でフリーのパイロット。廊下の天井が高い専用宇宙船を所有する。卵生。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Kal'Falnl C'ndros. '''Card text:''' When a battle occurs at Kal's location and each player draws one battle destiny, if your destiny is higher, your opponent's destiny becomes 0. Landspeed 3. Adds 2 to the power of a capital starship she pilots. Her legs are too long for her to board starfighters or enclosed vehicles. '''Lore:''' A female Quor'sav, a flying species resembling primitive mammals. She is 3.5 meters tall, an overprotective mother, and a freelance pilot. She owns a personal starship with high-ceilinged corridors. She lays eggs.

Title

リーサブ・サーリン

Card Text

毎ターン、自分の支配フェイズに、１フォース消費して相手の手札を１枚選び、カードのタイプを予測する。カードを公開し、あたればロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-leesub-sirln-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''リーサブは、人類の近縁種クイラッシュで、奴隷として育てられた。限定された未来予知の能力を持つ。帝国の高等調査官トレメインによって、フォースの達人と認められたが、脱走してモス・アイズリーに身を潜める。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Leesub Sirln. '''Card text:''' During your control phase each turn, use 1 Force to select a card from your opponent's hand and predict its card type. Reveal the card. If your prediction is correct, the card is lost. '''Lore:''' Leesub is a near-human Qiraash who was raised as a slave. She has a limited ability to foresee the future. Imperial High Inquisitor Tremayne recognized her as an adept of the Force, but she escaped and went into hiding in Mos Eisley.

Title

Card Text

タトゥイーン以外のロケーションにルークがいる場合、毎ターン、フォースを１多く起動できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋３。レッド５を操縦する場合、さらに回避値に＋２。耐：損耗＜３。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-luke-skywalker-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''アナキン・スカイウォーカーの息子。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子。Ｔ－１６スカイホッパーに乗って、ベガーズ・キャニオンのウォンプ・ラットを狙い撃ちして操縦技能を磨いた。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Luke Skywalker. '''Card text:''' While Luke is at a location other than Tatooine, you may activate 1 additional Force each turn. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When he pilots Red 5, also add 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' Anakin Skywalker's son and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s apprentice. He honed his piloting skills by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon from his T-16 skyhopper.

支配フェイズに、同じ位置にいる動物（バンサ、デューバック、ワンパ、ランコア、ブーボ、ドラゴンスネーク）を罠にかける（盗む）ことができる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-momaw-nadon-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

'''Lore:''' A tree-loving male Ithorian derogatorily called Hammerhead. An expert in breeding animals and cultivating plants. Former commander of a cultivation ship. A Rebel spy.

Title

オビ=ワン・ケノービ

Card Text

戦闘開始時から参加していたら、１フォース消費して、能力値＝１の相手のキャラクターを一人選び、移動を強要する（移動コストなし）。移動しなかったら、そのキャラクターを直ちにロストデッキへ置く。耐：損耗＜５。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-obi-wan-kenobi-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''ジェダイの騎士。ヨーダの教えを受けた。ベイル・オーガナの友人。ケノービ将軍はクローン大戦時に旧共和国軍の英雄となった。アナキンとルーク・スカイウォーカーの導師。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Obi-Wan Kenobi. '''Card text:''' If he has participated since the start of a battle, use 1 Force to select an opposing character with ability 1 and force it to move at no movement cost. If it does not move, place it in the Lost Pile immediately. Immune to attrition less than 5. '''Lore:''' A Jedi Knight taught by Yoda and a friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic's military during the Clone Wars. Mentor to Anakin and [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]].

Card Text

「ラーズ家のモイスチャー・ファーム」へ配備するのなら配備コスト不要。「ベルー・ラーズ」か「ヴァーポレーター」と同じ位置カードにいれば、戦闘力＋２。相手のターンにロストデッキへ行った場合、次の自分のターンが終了するまで、ルークの戦闘力に＋３。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-owen-lars-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

Title

R4-E1（アーフォー・イーワン）

Card Text

ビークル（乗用クリーチャーは除く）にのみ配備し、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度に＋1。常にビークルに乗っていることができ、その時は人員なしで移動できる。宇宙船用の操縦ドロイドとしての能力はない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-25o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''ビークルのコンピュータ操作用ドロイドの一体。製造はインダストリアル・オートマトン社。このユニット、R4-E1はボシェックに付き添っている。無鉄砲で独立心旺盛。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone). '''Card text:''' Deploy only on a vehicle (except a creature vehicle). Power, maneuver, and landspeed +1. May remain aboard and move the vehicle with no other personnel. Has no astromech capability. '''Lore:''' A vehicle computer droid by Industrial Automaton. This unit, R4-E1, accompanies BoShek. Reckless and fiercely independent.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Title

レッド・リーダー

Card Text

彼が操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋2。レッド1に乗っていれば、さらに回避値＋1し、戦闘運命数が引けない場合に、1枚だけ引ける。同じ位置にいるレッド中隊の他のパイロットは全員没収値に＋1。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-29o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''Xウイングのパイロット、ガーヴェン・ドライス。ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド中隊を率い、デス・スターの排熱孔に一発打ち込んだが、外れた。ダントウイン反乱軍基地に勤務していた。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Red Leader. '''Card text:''' A starship he pilots is power +2. If aboard Red 1, also maneuver +1, and he may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Each other Red Squadron pilot at the same location is forfeit +1. '''Lore:''' X-wing pilot Garven Dreis. Led Red Squadron at Yavin and fired on the Death Star exhaust port, but missed. Served at the Dantooine Rebel base.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Red Leader]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Title

タルズ

Card Text

武器が命中した他のキャラクターと同じ位置カードにいれば、その代わりに没収してよい。命中を受けたキャラクターは元にもどされる。「夜間状態」にあるタルズは、戦闘力に＋２。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-31o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''マフタックは、帝国が隷属化した星系の内、アルゾックＩＩＩ出身のタルズ人男性である。二対の目の内小さな方は優れた暗視能力を持つ。マフタックはカーベの友人で保護者。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Talz. '''Card text:''' If at the same site as another character just hit by a weapon, may forfeit in that character's place. The hit character is restored. A Talz under nighttime conditions is power +2. '''Lore:''' Muftak is a male Talz from Alzoc III, a system enslaved by the Empire. The smaller pair of eyes gives excellent night vision. Muftak is a friend and protector of Kabe.

Japanese-language printing of [[Talz]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Title

ＷＥＤ－９－Ｍ１ “バンサ” ドロイド

Card Text

同じ位置カードにいるすべてのビークルとドロイドは、耐：損耗＜２。“バンサ”ドロイドがドッキング・ベイにいれば、同じ星系カードにいるすべての宇宙戦闘機は、耐：損耗＜３。「予期せぬ損傷」のカードをキャンセルできる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-32o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''ジャワがパーツを寄せ集めて作った、地上にただ一台のトレッドウェル・ドロイド。今はドッキング・ベイ９４の管理者、デマルズが所有している。鈍重で頑固な性格から、“バンサ”と呼ばれている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' WED-9-M1 “Bantha” Droid. '''Card text:''' All vehicles and droids at the same site are immune to attrition less than 2. If Bantha Droid is at a docking bay, all starfighters at the same system are immune to attrition less than 3. May cancel Unexpected Damage. '''Lore:''' A one-of-a-kind Treadwell droid assembled from parts by Jawas. It now belongs to Demalz, the overseer of Docking Bay 94. Its sluggish, stubborn nature earned it the name Bantha.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. '''Title:''' WED-9-M1 “Bantha” Droid. '''Card text:''' All vehicles and droids at the same site are immune to attrition less than 2. If Bantha Droid is at a docking bay, all starfighters at the same system are immune to attrition less than 3. May cancel Unexpected Damage. '''Lore:''' A one-of-a-kind Treadwell droid assembled from parts by Jawas. It now belongs to Demalz, the overseer of Docking Bay 94. Its sluggish, stubborn nature earned it the name Bantha.

Title

ワイオスリー

Card Text

自分の支配フェイズの間、１フォース消費して、同じ位置カードにいる相手のビークルまたはドロイドを対象にして“購入”してよい。運命数を引く。運命数＞対象の運命数ならば、対象の配備コストと等しいフォースを“支払って”（消費して）、その対象を手にいれる。

Lore

''ルークのランドスピーダーを買ったスペースポート・スピーダーズのヴーヴリアン女性。ジャバ・ザ・ハットに1000クレジットの借金があるギャンブラー。多くの言語を話す。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Wioslea. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, you may spend 1 Force to target an opponent's vehicle or droid at the same location card for ‘purchase.’ Draw destiny. If it is greater than the target's destiny number, ‘pay’ (spend) Force equal to the target's deploy cost and obtain that target. '''Lore:''' A Vuvrian woman of Spaceport Speeders who bought Luke's landspeeder. A gambler who owes Jabba the Hutt 1,000 credits. Speaks many languages. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the amount owed a debt; the English identifies it as a wagering debt. The Japanese describes obtaining the target after paying its deploy cost; the English says to take the target.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Wioslea]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Title

エローズ・マダック

Card Text

どちらかを選ぶ。１：ドロイドを除く、パイロットでないキャラクターに配備し、パイロット技能［パイロットアイコン］を与える。そのキャラクターが操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力は＋２される。２：パイロットに配備し、キャラクターが操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力にさらに＋１する。（「意識操作」の影響を受けない）[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-49o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''デュロスの常として、マダックも生まれつき操縦、航法術の腕ききだ。昔は偵察員で今はフリーの操縦コーチ。セラノン、バイブローズ、ヤガ・マイナーといった要所を駆けめぐる。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Ellorrs Madak. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Deploy on a non-pilot character other than a droid and give that character pilot skill. A starship that character pilots is power +2. 2. Deploy on a pilot and add a further 1 to the power of a starship the character pilots. Immune to Alter. '''Lore:''' Like other Duros, Madak is a natural at piloting and navigation. Formerly a scout, he is now a freelance flight instructor who travels between places such as Seranon, Byblos, and Yaga Minor.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Ellorrs Madak]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Title

マンテリアン・サヴリップ

Card Text

３フォース消費して、場の自分の側に配備する（Ｃ－３ＰＯが場にでていれば、配備コスト０）。戦闘に負けた際、手札からキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークルのカードを、カードの没収値の値で没収して、戦闘ダメージや、損耗値を減らすことができる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Mantellian-Savrip-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''デジャリックとは、銀河中の猛獣や、伝説上の怪物のホログラムを使って遊ぶゲームである。マンテリアン・サヴリップは、オード・マンテルの獰猛な肉食獣である。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Mantellian Savrip. '''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on your side of the table, or deploy for 0 if [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]] is on the table. When you lose a battle, you may forfeit character, starship, or vehicle cards from your hand at their printed forfeit values to reduce battle damage or attrition. '''Lore:''' Dejarik is a game played with holograms of fierce animals and legendary monsters from across the galaxy. The [[Mantellian Savrip|Mantellian Savrip]] is a ferocious carnivore from Ord Mantell.

Title

'''Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

助けて下さい、オビ＝ワン・ケノービ

Card Text

どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配する位置にオビ＝ワンがいる時に使う。このターンの間、オビ＝ワンの能力値を好きなだけ減らし、減らした分を、任意のロケーションでの戦闘の合計能力値に足せる。2：戦闘が起こった際、隣接した位置に反乱軍がいれば、1名選んで、リアクションとして戦闘が始まった位置に移動できる。

Lore

''レイアは要請をホログラムに託した。「ケノービ将軍、かつてクローン大戦の際、あなたは我が父に仕えてくださいました。帝国軍と戦うため、再びあなたの力が必要なのです。」''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi. '''Lore:''' Leia entrusted her request to a hologram. ‘General Kenobi, during the Clone Wars you served my father. To fight the Imperial forces, your help is needed again.’ '''Game text:''' Choose one. 1: Use when Obi-Wan is at a location you control. For this turn, you may reduce Obi-Wan's ability by any amount and add the amount reduced to the total ability in battle at any location. 2: When a battle occurs, if a Rebel is at an adjacent location, choose one and move that person as a reaction to the location where the battle began. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English lore says Leia's father asks Kenobi for help in his struggle; the Japanese says help is needed again to fight the Imperial forces. The English game text refers to a site you control, applying ability toward drawing battle destiny at another location, and ability used this way not being usable again that turn. The Japanese text instead refers to a controlled location, adding the reduction to total ability in battle at any location, and does not state the same restriction. The English second option specifies an adjacent battle site; the Japanese uses location.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p.41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

See Also

* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese|Japanese publications]]

Title

ミレニアム・ファルコン

Card Text

Lore

''YT-1300貨物船の改造版。ランド・カルリシアンがサバックの賭で負けて、ハンに譲った。全長26.7メートル。「見てくれは悪いが、中身はすごいんだぜ！」''

'''Title:''' Millennium Falcon '''Card text:''' May carry 2 pilots and up to 2 passengers. If Han, Chewie or Lando is piloting, gains immunity to attrition <5. Has docking capability. "It may look bad, but it's amazing inside!" '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the docking capability ドッキング能力.

Japanese-language printing of [[Millennium Falcon]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Title

リフト・チューブ

Card Text

4名の乗客を運べる。屋内の移動要塞の位置カードにのみ配備／移動できる。人員なしでの移動が可能。戦闘およびフォース消耗へのリアクションとして、動ける範囲で移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-148o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''密閉型で、垂直水平両方向に高速で移動する輸送シリンダー。宇宙ステーションや、大型艦で主に使用されている。反重力フィールドを使用。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Lift Tube. '''Card text:''' May carry 4 passengers. Deploy and move only at interior mobile sites. May move with no personnel aboard. May move as a react to a battle or Force drain within range. '''Lore:''' An enclosed transport cylinder that moves fast vertically and horizontally. Used on space stations and capital ships. Uses an antigrav field.

Title

８名までの乗客を運べる。タトゥイーンの位置カードに配備せねばならない。惑星の位置カードにしか移動できない。屋外の位置カードにいる場合、そこにいるジャワは没収値が＋１される。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-150o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''家畜小屋のような密閉型住居運搬用ビークル。タトゥイーンの略奪者から身を守る。元来は鉱物採掘車であり、鉱床閉鎖に伴い、ジャワ族が手に入れた。二つと同じ物はない。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Sandcrawler. '''Card text:''' May carry up to eight passengers. Must deploy at a Tatooine site. May move only to planetary sites. At an exterior site, Jawas there are forfeit +1. '''Lore:''' An enclosed vehicle for carrying living quarters, rather like a livestock shed. It protects against Tatooine raiders. Originally mining vehicles, they were acquired by Jawas when the mines closed. No two are alike.

Title

Card Text

同じ位置に「モッティ」か「ユレイレン」がいると、戦闘力＋１になる。同じロケーションに敵のドロイドか、自分のマウス・ドロイドを配備する場合、配備コスト＋１となる。「夜間状態」には、損耗の対象にならない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-163o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''モッティ提督の補佐を務める。陰湿で執念深く、他のドロイドたちから恐れられている。ＩＳＢのスパイで、忠誠心に疑いのある帝国軍の将校を密かに監視している。''

'''Title:''' 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix). '''Card text:''' If Motti or Yularen is at the same site, power +1. Opponent's droids or your mouse droids deploy +1 at the same location. During nighttime conditions, this droid is not subject to attrition. '''Lore:''' Aide to Admiral Motti. Foul-tempered and vindictive, and feared by other droids. An ISB spy who secretly watches Imperial officers whose loyalty is in doubt.

'''Admiral Motti''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

モッティ提督

Card Text

場に帝国軍の宇宙船が２隻以上出ていれば、配備コスト－２となる。モッティと同じ星系にいる反乱軍パイロットは、没収値－１となる。モッティが操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。

Lore

''デス・スターの指揮を任されている帝国宇宙軍司令官。科学技術を過信し、フォースを蔑視する。野心的な帝国軍のリーダー。皇帝の勅命を支持して昇進したが、軍事能力は評価されていない。ベイダーを嫌っている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Admiral Motti. '''Card text:''' If at least two Imperial starships are on the table, deploy cost is −2. Rebel pilots in the same system as Motti have forfeit −1. A starship Motti pilots has power +2. '''Lore:''' An Imperial Navy commander entrusted with command of the Death Star. He puts excessive faith in technology and despises the Force. An ambitious Imperial leader. He was promoted for supporting the Emperor's decree, but his military ability is not highly regarded. He dislikes Vader. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says Motti supported the Emperor's decree, while the English printed lore says he supported the New Order. The Japanese says his military ability is not highly regarded; the English says he was promoted because of his support rather than his military skills.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Admiral Motti]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

ドクター・エヴァザン

Card Text

同じ位置にいる、武器が命中したか、「切断された腕」をつけられたキャラクターを、即座に“手術”する。が、腕が悪いので患者は、即座にロストする。彼の操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-172o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''密輸屋。顔に醜いブラスター痕のある心の歪んだ“医師”。１２以上の星系で死刑判決。ポンダ・バーバの悪名高きパートナー。別名、ドクター・コーネリアス・ルーフー。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Dr. Evazan. '''Card text:''' Immediately “operates” on a character at the same site that was just hit by a weapon or that has Disarmed. The patient is immediately lost. A starship he pilots is power +2. '''Lore:''' Smuggler. A twisted “doctor” with an ugly blaster scar. Death sentence in 12 or more systems. Notorious partner of Ponda Baba. Alias Dr. Cornelius Rooboo. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 切断された腕 for Disarmed.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Dr. Evazan]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Icons[[Droid]]
'''EG-6 (Eegee-Six)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

ＥＧ－６（イージー・シックス）

Card Text

その場にいるパワー・ドロイド以外のドロイドの戦闘力を、全て＋１する。このカードの運命数の＊は０である。ただし、戦闘運命数として引いた場合で、味方の戦闘力合計が敵よりも小さい場合に限り、戦闘力合計を２倍にする。この効果は、１度の戦闘に１回しか使えない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-175o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''ヴェリル・ライン・システムズ社製の可動式パワージェネレーター。機器類やビークルの補給用。思考回路は単純。このユニットはメモリーを消去されたため、名前も製造番号も覚えていない。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' EG-6 (Eegee-Six). '''Card text:''' Each of your droids present except power droids is power +1. This card's * destiny is 0. If drawn as a battle destiny where your total power is less than the opponent's, double your total power. Once per battle. '''Lore:''' A mobile power generator by Veril Line Systems, to support equipment and vehicles. Simple thinking circuits. This unit had its memory wiped, so it does not know its name or serial number.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[EG-6 (Eegee-Six)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

ガリンダン

Card Text

同じ位置に、能力値＞２の反乱軍キャラクターがいれば、その場の帝国軍キャラクターの配備コストが－１になる。また、隣接した位置からその場へ帝国軍キャラクターが移動する場合の移動コストが０になる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-177o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''クビンディ出身の鼻の長いクバーズ人男性。スパイ。ドッキング・ベイ９４の外でオビ＝ワンとルークの行方を密告した。金次第でジャバ・ザ・ハットなどにつく。意外と臆病。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Garindan. '''Card text:''' If a Rebel of ability > 2 is at the same site, Imperial characters here deploy -1. Imperial characters moving here from an adjacent site move for 0. '''Lore:''' A long-nosed Kubaz male from Kubindi. Spy. Informed on Obi-Wan and Luke outside Docking Bay 94. Works for Jabba the Hutt or whoever pays. Unexpectedly timid.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Garindan]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Title

タッグ将軍

Card Text

同じ位置に帝国軍トルーパー（どのタイプでもよい）が１名いるごとに、タッグの没収値が＋１される。

Lore

''デス・スターの防衛任務を統括する傑出した戦術家。堅実なリーダー。有力な貴族階級かつ宇宙兵器コングロマリットを運営するタッグ家の一員。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' General Tagge. '''Card text:''' Tagge's forfeit is increased by 1 for each Imperial trooper of any type at the same location. '''Lore:''' An outstanding tactician who oversees the Death Star's defense operations. A steady leader. A member of the powerful noble House of Tagge, which operates a space-weapons conglomerate. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese game text refers to troopers at the same location; the English specifies troopers present with Tagge at a site. The Japanese lore describes a space-weapons conglomerate, while the English says a corporate conglomerate.

Title

帝国軍警備兵員

Card Text

移動できない。＊攻撃時は、戦闘力＝０で、防御時は、戦闘力＝４となる。

Lore

''戦術や武器に長けたエリート兵士。デス・スター配属のタジス・ドゥアミンなどがその典型例で、重要拠点に配置されている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Imperial guard personnel. '''Card text:''' Cannot move. *When attacking, power = 0; when defending, power = 4. '''Lore:''' Elite soldiers skilled in tactics and weapons. Tajis Durmin, assigned to the Death Star, is a typical example; they are stationed at important locations. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English lore specifies guarding key areas of the Death Star. The Japanese says they are stationed at important locations, while identifying Tajis Durmin as assigned to the Death Star. The Japanese game text uses the shorter expressions ‘when attacking’ and ‘when defending’ for the English printing's offensive and defensive battles.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Trooper Guard]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. '''MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

ＭＳＥ－６ “マウス” ドロイド

Card Text

ウーティーニー・エフェクトの対象となっている任意のキャラクターに配備する。キャラクターの代わりに“マウス”ドロイドを移動させて、ウーティーニー・エフェクトを持ち帰ったり、同じ場所に移動して、キャンセルしたりすることができる。移動速度＝３。ウーティーニー・エフェクトを運んだ後、“マウス”ドロイドは手札に戻る。

Lore

''外見から、マウスと呼ばれている。各種命令や重要書類を届けるのが役目。収納式のマニピュレータ内蔵。レバックサン・コルムーニ製。気が小さく、臆病なドロイド。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any character targeted by an Utinni Effect. Instead of the character, move the 'mouse' droid to bring back the Utinni Effect, or move it to the same place to cancel it. Landspeed = 3. After carrying the Utinni Effect, the 'mouse' droid returns to your hand. '''Lore:''' Called 'mouse' because of its appearance. Its job is to deliver various orders and important documents. Contains retractable manipulators. Made by Rebaxan Colmuni. A timid, cowardly droid. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese describes bringing back the Utinni Effect or moving to the same place to cancel it. The English says to bring it back to be fulfilled or canceled. The Japanese lore calls the droid timid and cowardly; the English describes it as easily frightened.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

＊ポンダ・バーバ

Card Text

ドクター・エヴァザンのいる位置カードで戦闘を行う場合、戦闘力を＋３できる。ただし、そこに相手のライトセーバーがない場合に限る。ポンダ・バーバが操縦している宇宙船の戦闘力は＋２される。

Lore

''クアラ（指のあるアクアリッシュ）の男性。殺し屋にして密輸屋。相棒のドクター・エヴァザンに、性能の悪い人工生体の義手を移植される。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Ponda Baba. '''Card text:''' When battling at a site where [[Dr. Evazan]] is present, you may add 3 to Ponda Baba's power, but only if none of your opponent's lightsabers is there. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. '''Lore:''' A male Quara (a fingered Aqualish), an assassin and smuggler. His partner Dr. Evazan fitted him with a poorly functioning bioprosthetic hand.

Characteristics

* Male * Quara (Aqualish) * Smuggler

Notes

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The later [[Ponda Baba (Errata)|English errata]] says anything he pilots.[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, Ponda Baba entry. Japanese-language printing of [[Ponda Baba]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

女予言者

Card Text

女預言者のいる場所で戦闘を宣言した場合、戦闘を開始する前に、どちらが勝つかを予測して相手に告げる（必ず行うこと）。戦闘の結果が予測どおりなら、君はロストしたカードを無作為に１枚、再使用できる。予測がはずれたなら、１フォースを失う。耐：損耗＜３。

Lore

''名高い超能力者。凶運を察知する女性。タトゥイーンの統治者アリオンの使者。ハン・ソロに会うため、ドッキング・ベイ94に向かったジャバと手下どもの後をつけた。''

'''Lore:''' A renowned psychic who senses ill fortune, and an agent of Aryon, ruler of Tatooine. She followed Jabba and his subordinates to Docking Bay 94, where they went to meet Han Solo. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to tell the opponent the prediction and that a randomly selected lost card may be reused. The English requires a prediction and says to randomly retrieve one lost card. The Japanese lore says Jabba's party went to meet Han; the English says they confronted him.

Japanese-language printing of [[Prophetess]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Title

R1-G4（アーワン・ジーフォー）

Card Text

大型艦に乗っているなら、戦闘力と航行速度に＋１する。また、その宇宙船は耐：損耗＜３を得る。大きすぎて宇宙戦闘機には乗せられない。

Lore

''普及した旧式操縦ドロイドで、今でも大型の宇宙船や貨物船で使用されている。マークII・リアクター・ドローンの外殻に身を包む。所有者が捕えられ、R1-G4は廃棄された。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' R1-G4 (Arone-Geefour). '''Card text:''' If aboard a capital ship, adds 1 to power and travel speed. That starship also gains immunity to attrition < 3. Too large to be placed aboard a starfighter. '''Lore:''' A widespread older-model piloting droid still used on large starships and freighters. Encased in the shell of a Mark II reactor drone. R1-G4 was discarded after its owner was captured. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes an older piloting droid used on large starships and freighters; the English describes an old-model astromech used on capital starships and large freighters. The Japanese refers to the reactor drone's shell; the English describes it as armored.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[R1-G4 (Arone-Geefour)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

R4-M9（アーフォー・エムナイン）

Card Text

任意のビークル（乗用生物を除く）に配備する。そのビークルの戦闘力、回避値、移動速度にそれぞれ＋１する。人員がいなくても、このドロイド単独で搭乗し、ビークルを操縦することができる。操縦ドロイドとしての能力は持たない。

Lore

''典型的な多目的ドロイド。ビークルやコンピュータを操作／修理する。帝国軍がタンティヴィIVのコンピュータ・バンクから情報を引き出すのに使用したのが、R4-M9である。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' R4-M9 (Arfour-Emmnine). '''Card text:''' Deploy on any vehicle (except a creature vehicle). Add 1 to that vehicle's power, maneuver and landspeed. Even without personnel, this droid can remain aboard alone and drive the vehicle. It has no capability as an astromech droid. '''Lore:''' A typical multipurpose droid. Operates/repairs vehicles and computers. R4-M9 is the droid the Empire used to extract information from Tantive IV's computer banks. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says there need not be personnel aboard; the English says the droid may drive by itself without presence. Both give +1 power, maneuver and landspeed to a non-creature vehicle and deny astromech capability. The Japanese lore omits the English word once.[ Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 5:46.

Notes

Droids have no ability. The 2023 Advanced Rulebook treats a droid's ability as an unmodifiable zero when a card compares. 77, Characters - Droid. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

ストームトルーパー

Card Text

能力値＞２の帝国軍がいる位置にはコストなしで配備できる。

Lore

''皇帝に完全な忠誠を誓う精鋭突撃部隊の名も無き一員。命令には無条件で従い、任務のために命を投げ出すことを厭わない。最前線の速攻部隊。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Stormtrooper. '''Card text:''' May deploy without cost at a site where an Imperial with ability greater than 2 is present. '''Lore:''' A nameless member of elite shock troops who swear complete loyalty to the Emperor. Follows orders unconditionally and does not hesitate to sacrifice his life for a mission. A frontline rapid-strike force. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese free-deployment sentence does not explicitly say your Imperial; the English says one of your Imperials. The Japanese lore calls the trooper nameless, where the English says one of countless troops. Both printed faces have deploy 1, power 1, ability 1 and forfeit 2. The conditional free deployment is separate from the printed deploy statistic.[ Japanese printed face], PSA; [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/1/1d/Premiere-D-stormtrooper.gif English printed face].

Title

タスケン・レイダー

Card Text

＊タスケン・レイダーの合計戦闘力は、その場所にいる人数の合計で変化する。合計戦闘力は、１名であれば１、２名＝３、３名＝６、４名＝１０となる。１つの位置カードには４名までしかおけない。タトゥイーンにしか配備できないが、そこからなら好きなところへ移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-196o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''別称サンド・ピープル。ゴーグルと呼吸マスクを顔に装着している。バンサに騎乗し、ガッフィの杖を振るう。好戦的で、砂漠で生活する。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Tusken Raider. '''Card text:''' Tusken Raiders' total power depends on how many are at that site. Total power is 1 for one, 3 for two, 6 for three, and 10 for four. No more than four may be at a site. Deploy only to Tatooine. From there, they may move anywhere. '''Lore:''' Also known as Sand People. They wear goggles and breathing masks, ride banthas, and wield gaffi sticks. They are warlike and live in the desert.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Tusken Raider]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Title

ＷＥＤ１５－Ｉ６６２ “トレッドウェル” ドロイド

Card Text

同じ場所にいる自分のビークルとドロイドはすべて、耐：損耗＜２を得る。また、“トレッドウェル”ドロイドがドッキング・ベイにいるなら、同一星系にいる自分の宇宙戦闘機はすべて耐：損耗＜３を得る。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-197o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''標準型のトレッドウェル・ドロイド。通称アイシックスシックストゥ。大型機械や宇宙戦闘機の補修などに数千体が稼動している。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' WED15-I662 “Treadwell” Droid. '''Card text:''' All of your vehicles and droids at the same location gain immunity to attrition less than 2. If Treadwell Droid is at a docking bay, all your starfighters in the same system gain immunity to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' A standard Treadwell droid nicknamed I-Six-Six-Two. Thousands are in service repairing heavy machinery and starfighters.

Notes

Title

ウーハー

Card Text

自分の支配フェイズの開始時に、ウーハーと同じ位置カードにある武器とドロイドは、すべてロストする。カンティーナにいる場合、フェイズに関わらず、すべての武器とドロイドが即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-198o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''無愛想で冷淡なバーテン。店内にブラスターとドロイドは御法度。「ドロイドに出す酒はねぇ。」ジャバ・ザ・ハットの専属バーテンになるため、彼には常に最高の飲み物を出す。''

'''Title:''' Wuher. '''Card text:''' At the start of your control phase, all weapons and droids at Wuher's site are lost. At the Cantina, all weapons and droids there are lost immediately regardless of the phase. '''Lore:''' An unfriendly, aloof bartender. Blasters and droids are forbidden in his establishment. “I don't serve drinks to droids.” He always serves Jabba the Hutt his finest drinks in hopes of becoming Jabba's personal bartender.

''限定生産の偵察用軽宇宙機。装甲と火力は最小限のものしか持たない。長距離センサーと通信装備を持つ。反乱軍の行動を偵察する任務にあたる。''

Title

ベイダー専用タイ・ファイター

Card Text

パイロットを１名乗せることができる。パイロットがベイダーなら、専用タイは耐：損耗＜４を持つ。パイロットがいなければ、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使えない。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-306o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''タイ・アドバンストｘ１の試作限定生産の初号機。後継機タイ・インターセプター開発の基礎となった。ベイダーの要請に応え、ハイパードライブが組み込まれている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Vader's Personal TIE Fighter. '''Card text:''' May carry one pilot. If Vader is the pilot, this TIE is immune to attrition less than 4. Without a pilot, it cannot use its power, maneuver, or hyperspeed. '''Lore:''' The first of a limited run of TIE Advanced x1 prototypes. It formed the basis for the later TIE Interceptor. A hyperdrive was installed at Vader's request.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Vader's Custom TIE]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Title

バンサ

Card Text

乗客を2名乗せることができる。バンサの能力値は、1/2である。戦闘やフォース消耗へのリアクションとして、移動範囲内の位置へ移動できる。同じ屋外の位置にいるタスケン・レイダーは、戦闘力＋１になる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-307o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''貨客両用の動物で、さまざまな大きさと色のものがある。体高は約3メートル。水も食料も無しで何週間も動きまわれるので、銀河の各地で飼育されている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Bantha. '''Card text:''' May carry 2 passengers. Bantha ability is 1/2. May move as a react to a battle or Force drain within range. Each Tusken Raider at the same exterior site is power +1. '''Lore:''' A pack and passenger animal in many sizes and colors. About 3 meters tall. Can go weeks without food or water, so it is kept across the galaxy.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Bantha]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Title

サンドクローラー

Card Text

８名までの乗客を運べる。タトゥイーンの位置カードに配備する。惑星の位置カードにしか移動させることができない。屋外の位置カードにいる場合、そこにいるジャワは没収値が＋１される。

Lore

''家畜小屋のようなジャワ族の密閉型住居。タスケン・レイダーやクレイト・ドラゴンなどから身を守る。長さ６m全高17m。元来は鉱物採掘用ビークルで、全て形が異なる。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Sandcrawler. '''Card text:''' May carry up to eight passengers. Deploy at a Tatooine site. May move only to planet sites. When at an exterior site, Jawas there have forfeit +1. '''Lore:''' Enclosed homes of Jawa tribes resembling livestock sheds. They protect against Tusken Raiders, krayt dragons and the like. Six meters long and seventeen meters high. Originally vehicles for mineral excavation; all are differently shaped. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore prints a length of 6 meters; the English printed face says 36 meters. Both give a height of 17 meters. The Japanese describes a livestock shed rather than the English warren-like home. Both game texts give eight passengers, Tatooine-site deployment, relocation only to planet sites, and +1 forfeit to Jawas at the same exterior site.[ Japanese printed face], PSA. [ English printed face].

Sources

* [ Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA. * [ Sandcrawler Japanese printed face], PSA. * [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 100 (Japanese Premiere checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

'''Lore:''' Enclosed homes of Jawa tribes resembling livestock sheds. They protect against Tusken Raiders, krayt dragons and the like. Six meters long and seventeen meters high. Originally vehicles for mineral excavation; all are differently shaped. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore prints a length of 6 meters; the English printed face says 36 meters. Both give a height of 17 meters. The Japanese describes a livestock shed rather than the English warren-like home. Both game texts give eight passengers, Tatooine-site deployment, relocation only to planet sites, and +1 forfeit to Jawas at the same exterior site.[ Japanese printed face], PSA. [ English printed face].

rows.text:
{{Set infobox |name=Premiere (Japanese) |image=Premiere-Japanese-box.png |publisher=[[Decipher]] / [[Takara]] |era=[[:Category:Decipher sets|Decipher]] (1995–2001) |released=April 1997 |cards=324 (162 Light, 162 Dark) |code=GEMP set 1301 |country=Japan |language=Japanese |next=[[A New Hope (Japanese)]] |related=[[Premiere Limited]] · [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] }} '''Premiere (Japanese)''' (基本カード) is the Japanese-language edition of [[Premiere Limited]]. [[Takara]] published it in Japan in April 1997 as スターウォーズコレクションカードゲーム. It has 324 black-border cards, 162 Light Side and 162 Dark Side, 108 of each rarity. Decipher and Takara announced the partnership in December 1996. Steve Stanley, Decipher Senior Vice President and General Counsel, visited Tokyo for Takara's introduction of the set. Takara demonstrated it at the Tokyo Toy Show, 19–23 March 1997, at Tokyo Big Sight. The first three days were trade only. The last two days were open to the public. Takara's gameplay demonstrations had standing room only. Hirohisa Satoh, Jr., President of Takara Ltd., hosted the display. Takara pre-sold more than 80 percent of the print run before street date. Takara was translating the Tournament Kit. Japan was placed in the newly created Ord Mantell region on Decipher's tournament locator. A Japanese champion was expected to compete at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]. Takara could not ship the Japanese cards outside Japan. The English Limited set is the 1st expansion of Star Wars CCG. This printing translates that 324-card pool. GEMP loads the Japanese faces as set 1301. English-language packs from [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] through [[Endor]] were sold in Japan with a Takara overlabel on the pack. Poor translations led Japanese players to prefer the English-language cards. Takara and Decipher ended the partnership after Japanese Premiere, [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope]], [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth]], and the two Japanese two-player games. [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] has a separate Japanese product. Language editions are listed on [[Translations of SWCCG]]. == Packaging == Takara sold 15-card booster packs (MSRP ¥500) in 36-pack boxes. Each pack had 10 commons, 4 uncommons and 1 rare. 60-card starters (MSRP ¥1400) came in 12-deck displays. Each starter had 44 commons (22 per side), 14 uncommons (7 per side), 2 rares (1 per side) and a Japanese rulebook. {| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;" |- style="background:transparent; border:none; vertical-align:bottom;" | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Premiere-Japanese-box.png|260px|Japanese booster box]]
''Booster box'' | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Premiere-Japanese-pack.png|200px|Japanese booster pack]]
''Booster pack'' | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Premiere-Japanese-starter-v2.png|200px|Japanese 60-card starter]]
''60-card starter'' |} [[File:Premiere-Japanese-pack-contents-v3.png|1200px|Japanese Premiere pack and starter contents]] ''15-card pack and 60-card starter contents'' Takara's product page highlighted eight main cards. [[File:Premiere-Japanese-mains.png|1200px|Japanese Premiere main cards]] ''Vader, Tarkin, C-3PO, Han, Leia, Luke, Falcon and Obi-Wan'' == Memorabilia == Takara issued player's guides for the Japanese edition. One guide is a fold-out with a Light Side and Dark Side card line-up. {| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;" |- style="background:transparent; vertical-align:top;" | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Premiere-Japanese-Takara-guides-v2.png|280px|Takara Premiere player's guides]]
''Takara player's guides'' | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Premiere-Japanese-Takara-guide-spread.jpg|720px|Takara Premiere player's guide fold-out]]
''Player's guide fold-out'' |} == Variants == Every Japanese [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (Japanese)|Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was printed on an Effect template instead of Interrupt. There was no corrected run, so it is not counted as a separate misprint. [[File:Premiere-Japanese-Help-Me-Obi-Wan-v2.png|320px|Japanese Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi Effect template]] ''[[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (Japanese)|Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi]]: English Interrupt vs Japanese Effect template'' About half of the Japanese [[Corellian Corvette (Japanese)|Corellian Corvette]] copies have a stray mark in the printed title. The mark is part of the print-sheet layout. [[File:Premiere-Japanese-Corellian-Corvette-title-mark-v2.png|480px|Japanese Corellian Corvette title mark]] ''[[Corellian Corvette (Japanese)|Corellian Corvette]]: unmarked title and print-sheet mark'' == Other printings == English-language packs from [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] through [[Endor]] were sold in Japan with a Takara overlabel on the pack. [[File:Premiere-Japanese-Takara-overlabel-packs.png|520px|Takara overlabels on English A New Hope and Dagobah packs]] ''English [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] and [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] packs with Takara overlabels'' The English edition is [[Premiere Limited]]. The Japanese [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] followed in 1997. Japanese-language foil versions of some Premiere cards were packed in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] and [[Reflections III]]. They belong to those English products. The foil list is on [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils]]. == See also == * [[Japanese Premiere Starter Deck]] * [[Premiere Limited]] * [[Premiere Unlimited]] * [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] * [[A New Hope (Japanese)]] * [[Hoth (Japanese)]] * [[Translations of SWCCG]] * [[Takara]] · [[Decipher]] · [[Star Wars CCG]] * [[1997 Decipher World Championship]] == References == [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 39–41, 48. {{Set infobox |name=Premiere (Japanese) |image=Premiere-Japanese-box.png |publisher=[[Decipher]] / [[Takara]] |era=[[:Category:Decipher sets|Decipher]] (1995–2001) |released=April 1997 |cards=324 (162 Light, 162 Dark) |code=GEMP set 1301 |country=Japan |language=Japanese |next=[[A New Hope (Japanese)]] |related=[[Premiere Limited]] · [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] }} '''Premiere (Japanese)''' (基本カード) is the Japanese-language edition of [[Premiere Limited]]. [[Takara]] published it in Japan in April 1997 as スターウォーズコレクションカードゲーム. It has 324 black-border cards, 162 Light Side and 162 Dark Side, 108 of each rarity. Decipher and Takara announced the partnership in December 1996. Steve Stanley, Decipher Senior Vice President and General Counsel, visited Tokyo for Takara's introduction of the set. Takara demonstrated it at the Tokyo Toy Show, 19–23 March 1997, at Tokyo Big Sight. The first three days were trade only. The last two days were open to the public. Takara's gameplay demonstrations had standing room only. Hirohisa Satoh, Jr., President of Takara Ltd., hosted the display. Takara pre-sold more than 80 percent of the print run before street date. Takara was translating the Tournament Kit. Japan was placed in the newly created Ord Mantell region on Decipher's tournament locator. A Japanese champion was expected to compete at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]. Takara could not ship the Japanese cards outside Japan. The English Limited set is the 1st expansion of Star Wars CCG. This printing translates that 324-card pool. GEMP loads the Japanese faces as set 1301. English-language packs from [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] through [[Endor]] were sold in Japan with a Takara overlabel on the pack. Poor translations led Japanese players to prefer the English-language cards. Takara and Decipher ended the partnership after Japanese Premiere, [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope]], [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth]], and the two Japanese two-player games. [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] has a separate Japanese product. Language editions are listed on [[Translations of SWCCG]]. == Packaging == Takara sold 15-card booster packs (MSRP ¥500) in 36-pack boxes. Each pack had 10 commons, 4 uncommons and 1 rare. 60-card starters (MSRP ¥1400) came in 12-deck displays. Each starter had 44 commons (22 per side), 14 uncommons (7 per side), 2 rares (1 per side) and a Japanese rulebook. {| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;" |- style="background:transparent; border:none; vertical-align:bottom;" | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Premiere-Japanese-box.png|260px|Japanese booster box]]

There was no corrected run, so it is not counted as a separate misprint. [[File:Premiere-Japanese-Help-Me-Obi-Wan-v2.png|320px|Japanese Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi Effect template]] ''[[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (Japanese)|Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi]]: English Interrupt vs Japanese Effect template'' About half of the Japanese [[Corellian Corvette (Japanese)|Corellian Corvette]] copies have a stray mark in the printed title. The mark is part of the print-sheet layout. [[File:Premiere-Japanese-Corellian-Corvette-title-mark-v2.png|480px|Japanese Corellian Corvette title mark]] ''[[Corellian Corvette (Japanese)|Corellian Corvette]]: unmarked title and print-sheet mark'' == Other printings == English-language packs from [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] through [[Endor]] were sold in Japan with a Takara overlabel on the pack. [[File:Premiere-Japanese-Takara-overlabel-packs.png|520px|Takara overlabels on English A New Hope and Dagobah packs]] ''English [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] and [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] packs with Takara overlabels'' The English edition is [[Premiere Limited]]. The Japanese [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] followed in 1997. Japanese-language foil versions of some Premiere cards were packed in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] and [[Reflections III]]. They belong to those English products. [[Boosted TIE Cannon (Japanese)|Boosted TIE Cannon]] || Weapon || U1 || 4 || 1フォース消費して、タイ・アドバンスト×1に配備する。1フォース使って、起動する。大型艦は、（運命数－1）＞装甲値ならば命中。宇宙戦闘機は、（運命数＋1）＞回避値ならば命中する。 |- | [[File:Japanese-Premiere-Dark-Jedi-Lightsaber-video.png|200px|link=Dark Jedi Lightsaber (Japanese)]] || [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber (Japanese)|Dark Jedi Lightsaber]] || Weapon || U1 || 2 || Ｘフォース消費して、戦士キャラクターに配備する（Ｘ＝７－戦士の能力値である）。使い方は、以下の２通り。１：ライトセーバーのある位置でのフォース消耗を＋１する。２：Ｘフォース消費して、キャラクターに対して起動する。運命数を２枚引く。運命数＞能力値ならば命中する。 |- | [[File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-14-Face.jpg|200px|link=Gaderffii Stick (Japanese)]] || [[Gaderffii Stick (Japanese)|Gaderffii Stick]] || Weapon || C2 || 4 || ２フォース消費して、タスケン・レイダーに配備する。起動にフォースを必要としない。その場で戦闘が始まった場合、即座に運命数を２枚引く。２枚の運命数の合計＞５ならば、敵は武器を“はじき飛ばされて”、この戦闘では使えなくなる。 |- | [[File:Japanese-Premiere-Han-Seeker-video.png|200px|link=Han Seeker (Japanese)]] || [[Han Seeker (Japanese)|Han Seeker]] || Weapon || R2 || 3 || ２フォース消費して屋内の位置カードに配備する。移動はできない。フォース消費なしで起動できる。運命数を引く。キャラクターなら、運命数－１＞能力値で、シーカーなら運命数＞２で命中する。他の武器でレーザー・グリッドを狙うこともできる。その場合、運命数＞１で命中する。 |- | [[File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-320o-Face.jpg|200px|link=Light Repeating Blaster Rifle (Japanese)]] || [[Light Repeating Blaster Rifle (Japanese)|Light Repeating Blaster Rifle]] || Weapon || R1 || 2 || ２フォース消費して任意の戦士に配備する。パワー・ドロイドか「融合ジェネレーター供給タンク」がある時のみ、２フォースで起動できる。運命数を引くこと。運命数＋１＞能力値で命中する。ビークルなら運命数＋１＞回避値／装甲値なら命中する。２フォース消費するごとに、何回でも起動できる。 |- | '''Chief Bast''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

バスト隊長

Card Text

戦闘のはじめに、宇宙船に乗っている場合、即座に、他に1名のキャラクターを連れて、同一星系内の位置に、即座に脱出（移送）することができる。ターキンと同じ位置にいる場合、戦闘力＋１。バストが操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-165o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''グランドモフ・ターキンの副官。決して敵を過小評価しない。若い頃に親しんだ狩りによって、狡猾さと忍耐力を身に付けたのだ。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Chief Bast. '''Card text:''' At the start of a battle, if aboard a starship, may immediately evacuate (relocate) with one other character to a site in the same system. Power +1 if at the same site as Tarkin. A starship Bast pilots is power +2. '''Lore:''' Aide to Grand Moff Tarkin. Never underestimates the enemy. Hunting as a youth taught cunning and patience. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese relocates to a site in the same system; the English relocates to a related site.

Notes

The preserved frame shows the Imperial and Pilot icons. Its lower edge is cropped, so it does not establish whether any additional icon is printed below the visible area. Japanese-language printing of [[Chief Bast]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

＊ウルフ・ユレイレン大佐

Card Text

ターキン、バスト隊長、ドドンナ将軍と同じ位置にいると、戦闘力＋１。

Lore

''帝国保安局（ＩＳＢ）の将校で、ターキンに情報を流すためにつきそっている。皇帝に無二の忠誠を尽くし、その意を満たすためなら、躊躇無く行動する。リーダー。''

He devotes unrivaled loyalty to the Emperor and acts without hesitation to fulfill his wishes. Leader. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card says location where the English says site. The Japanese lists the three characters without an explicit word for “or”; the English says Tarkin, Chief Bast or General Dodonna. The Japanese lore describes Yularen as personally loyal to the Emperor; the English says he is ordered to ensure absolute loyalty to the Emperor.

Title

＊プラージ少佐

Card Text

プラージのいるところでは、Ｃ－３ＰＯとＲ２－Ｄ２は、カードルールの内容を使えない。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２。デバステーターに乗っている場合、航行速度＋１となる。

Lore

''戦艦デバステーターで、ベイダーの副官を務めた。ベイダーの命により、タトゥイーンでデス・スターの設計図捜索の指揮を執る。カリダにある帝国宇宙軍アカデミーを優秀な成績で卒業している。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Major Praji. '''Card text:''' Where Praji is present, C-3PO and R2-D2 cannot use their card rules. Any starship he pilots is power +2. When aboard the Devastator, hyperspeed is +1. '''Lore:''' Served as Vader's aide aboard the warship Devastator. On Vader's orders, directed the search for the Death Star plans on Tatooine. Graduated with excellent results from the Imperial Navy Academy on Carida. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title uses the rank “major” (少佐); the English title uses “commander.” The Japanese text joins C-3PO and R2-D2 with “and,” while the English face uses “or.”

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Commander Praji]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=75s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 1:15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. Title

＊ミーユム・オニス

Card Text

自分の支配フェイズに、Ｘフォース消費して、相手の手札をすべて公開させることができる。Ｘ＝相手の手札の枚数である。その中に反乱軍の男性の単一カード（＊）かエイリアンの男性の単一カード（＊）があれば、それらのカードはすべてロストする。

Lore

''ヘネムスィの女性。連れ合いを儀式的に殺す習慣を持つ。航行税で難癖をつけられ、タトゥイーンに足止めをくらっている。舌鋒は鋭く、その名は「夜の百合」を意味する。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' M'iiyoom Onith. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, you may use X Force to make the opponent reveal their entire hand, where X is the number of cards in that hand. If it contains unique male Rebel or unique male alien cards, all those cards are lost. '''Lore:''' A female H'nemthe, whose kind ritually kills their mates. Held up on Tatooine by an objection over a passage tax. Her tongue is sharp, and her name means “night lily.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes an objection over a passage tax, while the English calls the tax questionable. The two game texts both cause the specified unique male Rebel and alien cards in the revealed hand to be lost.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[M'iiyoom Onith]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=295s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 4:55. Title

コーラー

Card Text

帝国軍、ジャワに配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置にあって行動規制ボルトにコントロールされているドロイドを１体盗むことができる。ドロイドを盗んだなら、行動規制ボルトは所有者の手札に戻る。

Lore

''行動規制ボルトに命令するための携帯装置。コーラーと行動規制ボルトは１対１で対応している。銀河規模で広く使われており、「オーナー」とも呼ばれている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Caller. '''Card text:''' May deploy on an Imperial or Jawa. During your control phase, you may steal one droid at the same location that is controlled by a [[Restraining Bolt]]. If you steal the droid, the restraining bolt returns to its owner's hand. '''Lore:''' A handheld device for commanding a restraining bolt. A caller and restraining bolt correspond one-to-one. Widely used throughout the galaxy, it is also called an “owner.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text says the droid must be at the same location; the English says the same site. Japanese lore states a one-to-one correspondence between caller and bolt, while the English says each caller can be keyed to a specific bolt.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Caller (Dark)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=57s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 0:57. Title

行動規制ボルト

Card Text

任意の位置カード上の好きなドロイドに配備する。そのドロイドは移動できず、カードルールを使用できない。同じ位置に別のドロイドがいれば、自分の支配フェイズに行動規制ボルトを（フォースを消費せずに）そのドロイドへ再配備できる。

Lore

''融合溶接器を使ってドロイドが内包する専用ソケットに固定接続する。ボルトはドロイドの回路を支配し、命令に逆らった場合にはその動きを停止させる。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Behavior-restriction bolt. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any droid you choose at any site card. That droid cannot move or use its game text. If another droid is at the same site, you may redeploy the Restraining Bolt to that droid during your control phase (without using Force). '''Lore:''' Fixed to the special socket built into a droid using a fusion welder. The bolt controls the droid's circuits and stops its movement if it disobeys orders. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese printed text specifies your control phase (支配フェイズ) for the free transfer. The English printed text specifies your deploy phase. Both prevent the affected droid from moving or using its game text, and require the other droid to be at the same site.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=352 Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 5:52. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. ''緊急時に、ブラスト・ドアを閉鎖しロックするためのコントロール・パネル。ルークは、帝国軍を足留めするために、ハンガー・ベイ３２７からパネルを撃った。''

Title

＊ジュリ・ジュース

Card Text

「カンティーナ（酒場）」「モス・アイズリー」「ジャバのセイル・バージ」のいずれかが場に出ている時に使う。好きなエイリアンに配備する。そのエイリアンは、戦闘の際に特殊能力を使えない（カーベに配備したなら、“盗む”こともできなくなる）。このカードをキャンセルするためには、そのエイリアンを上記以外の位置に、自分でビークルを“運転”せずに移動させる必要がある。

Lore

''酒場の定番の飲料。多くの種族に酔わせる効果がある。モス・アイズリーの盗賊カーベやチャドラ＝ファンの好物。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Juri Juice. '''Card text:''' Use when Cantina, Mos Eisley or Jabba's Sail Barge is on the table. Deploy on any alien. That alien cannot use special ability in battle; if deployed on Kabe, she also cannot steal. To cancel this card, the alien must move to a location other than those listed above without personally driving a vehicle. '''Lore:''' A standard cantina beverage that intoxicates many species. A favorite of Kabe, a Mos Eisley thief, and Chadra-Fan. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to cancel the card by moving the alien to a location other than those listed above; the English says to move that alien to one of those sites. The Japanese lore names Kabe and Chadra-Fan as fans of the drink; the English describes Kabe as a Chadra-Fan thief.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Juri Juice]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=239s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:59. Title

＊ルーク？どこにいるの、ルーク！

Card Text

任意のタトゥイーンの位置カードに配備する。反乱軍を１つ選んで対象とする。対象は戦闘力と没収値が－１（対象がルークなら－３）される。没収値が０以下になったならそのカードはロストする。対象がこのカードのいる位置に到着すれば、このカードはキャンセルされる。

Lore

''「わかった、今いくよ、ベルー叔母さん」''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Luke? Where are you, Luke! '''Card text:''' Deploy on any Tatooine location card. Choose one Rebel as a target. The target's power and forfeit are reduced by 1, or by 3 if the target is Luke. If its forfeit becomes 0 or less, the card is lost. This card is canceled when the target reaches its location. '''Lore:''' “All right, I'm coming now, Aunt Beru.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese permits deployment on a Tatooine location card; the English says a Tatooine site. The Japanese says the target is lost if its forfeit becomes zero or less; the English says it is lost if its forfeit reaches zero.

Luuuuke!]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=292s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 4:52. Title

しどろもどろのソロ

Card Text

以下のカードをキャンセルする。「ベイダー卿に報告」、「アクセス・リンク」、「反乱軍参謀」、「反乱軍増援兵」、「師の導き」、「まだ気を抜くな」、「スカイウォーカー（空駆ける者）たち」、「降格」、「共同攻撃」、「急襲」

Lore

''「あ～、ちょっとした武器の故障でして…、しかし万事順調です。こちらは異常なし。全く異常ありません。そちらは？」''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' A flustered Solo. Title

Card Text

敵のキャラクターが２名以上、武器が１つ以上配備されている位置での戦闘の開始時に、事故が起こる。運命数を引く。運命数＜その位置の敵キャラクターの人数ならば、その中の１名がロストする（ロストするキャラクターは、敵プレイヤーが選ぶ）。

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Unexpected damage. '''Card text:''' At the beginning of a battle at a location where two or more opposing characters and one or more weapons are deployed, an accident occurs. '''Lore:''' Even Rebel soldiers fully equipped with blast vests and helmets with blast shields cannot remain unharmed on a battlefield where grenades burst and panels explode. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a location where opposing characters and weapons are deployed; the English refers to a site where the opponent has those cards. The Japanese title means unexpected damage.

戦闘の際に、ダーク・ジェダイが１名でもいる時に使用する。１フォース消費して、その他の帝国軍カードの戦闘力を全て２倍にする。

Title

ジャワの屍体

Card Text

敵のジャワのいる位置で、２名以上のストームトルーパーがいる時に使う。どのジャワを何名対象にするか宣言して、運命数を引く。運命数＞ターゲットの人数ならば、ターゲットは全員ロストする。

Lore

''Ｒ２－Ｄ２の捜索中、多くのジャワがストームトルーパーに殺された。タスケン・レイダーの仕業に見せるためバンサやガッフィの杖が使われたが、オビ＝ワンの目は欺けなかった。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Jawa corpse. '''Card text:''' Use when two or more stormtroopers are at a location where the opponent has Jawas. Declare which Jawas and how many to target, then draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the number targeted, all targets are lost. '''Lore:''' During the search for R2-D2, many Jawas were killed by stormtroopers. Banthas and gaffi sticks were used to make it look like the work of Tusken Raiders, but Obi-Wan was not deceived. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to declare which Jawas and how many to target; the English says to target as many Jawas there as desired. The English explicitly says the targeted Jawas are immediately lost; the Japanese does not specify immediately.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Dead Jawa]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=103s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 1:43. '''Elis Helrot''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

エリス・ヘルロット

Card Text

１つの位置にいるキャラクターを、他の位置に移動させることができる（その位置にいるキャラクターなら、何名でも可）。運命数を引いて、エリスが要求した価格を決定する。運命数と同じだけのフォースを消費すれば、輸送してくれる。フォースを消費しなければ、エリスは消える（ロストする）。

Lore

''ギヴィン人のパイロット。宇宙空間の真空にも耐えられるよう体関節を密封できる。スパイスと奴隷をカラウーンへと送る。彼の宇宙船ヒンスラには、特別な改造が施してある。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Elis Helrot. '''Card text:''' You may move characters at one location to another location; any number of characters at that location may go. Draw destiny to determine the price Elis asks. If you use that much Force, he transports them. If you do not use the Force, Elis disappears and is lost. '''Lore:''' A Givin pilot who can seal his body joints to withstand the vacuum of space. He transports spice and enslaved people to Kala'uun. His ship, the Hinthra, has special modifications. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to characters at one location moving to another location; the English specifies your characters and sites. The Japanese says Elis is lost if the Force is not spent; the English describes the player declining transport.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Elis Helrot]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=151s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 2:31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. Title

退避なされますか？

Card Text

ターキンが乗船していない場合に使える。ロストしたばかりの大型艦に乗っていた全キャラクター、武器、アイテムは、脱出する（ロストしない）。それらは、好きな惑星上の位置か、自分の大型艦に置きなおす。

Lore

''脱出ポッドは、大半の宇宙船に搭載されている。しかし帝国軍将校にとって、脱出は臆病な行為とされている。「敵の攻撃を分析した結果、極めて危険であると判断いたしました。」''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Will you evacuate? '''Card text:''' May be used if Tarkin is not aboard. All characters, weapons and items aboard a capital starship that was just lost escape and are not lost. Place them at any location on a planet or aboard one of your capital starships. '''Lore:''' Escape pods are carried aboard most starships, but Imperial officers regard escape as a cowardly act. “After analyzing the enemy's attack, we have determined that the danger is extreme.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to items and a location on a planet; the English uses devices and one planet site. The Japanese quotation says the danger is extreme, while the English quotation says there is a danger.

Title

帝国軍コード・シリンダー

Card Text

帝国軍のリーダーが、アクセス・リンクのある位置にいる時に使う。どちらかを選ぶ。１：どちらのリザーブデッキでも、２０秒間見る。デッキをシャッフルしなおす。２：さらにデス・スターの位置にいるなら、「アクセス・リンク」「ガベージ・シュートに飛び込んで！」をキャンセルする。

Lore

''帝国軍将校は、アクセス・リンクを使うためのコード・シリンダーが給付されている。各人の保安レベルに合わせてシリンダーが設定されており、引き出せる情報が異なる。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Imperial Code Cylinder. '''Card text:''' Use when an Imperial leader is at a location with a Scomp link. Choose one: (1) Look at either Reserve Deck for 20 seconds, then reshuffle it. (2) If also at a Death Star location, cancel [[Scomp Link Access]] and [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]]. '''Lore:''' Imperial officers are issued code cylinders for using Scomp links. Each cylinder is set to its owner's security level, determining what information can be retrieved. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese specifies a location and a Death Star location; the English specifies presence with a Scomp link and a Death Star site. The Japanese lists the two cards to cancel without an explicit “or”; the English says to cancel one or the other. The Japanese says to reshuffle the Reserve Deck; the English says to shuffle, cut and replace it.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Code Cylinder]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=213s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:33. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. Title

帝国軍増援部隊

Card Text

相手の場のカードのキャラクターと宇宙船の数の合計が、自分のよりも多いとき、１フォース消費して運命数を引く。その数の分の「ストームトルーパー」または「タイ・ファイター」をロストデッキから取り戻して再使用できる。

Lore

''帝国軍のストームトルーパーは、１個分隊８～１０名で構成されている。作戦行動を取る場合は、増援部隊から人員を補充するのが、通常の手順である。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Imperial reinforcement unit. '''Card text:''' When the opponent has more characters and starships in play in total than you do, use 1 Force and draw destiny. You may retrieve that number of Stormtroopers or TIE fighters from the Lost Deck for reuse. '''Lore:''' Imperial stormtrooper squads consist of eight to ten soldiers. During operations, the usual procedure is to replenish personnel from reinforcement units. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese connects Stormtroopers and TIE fighters with “or”; the English says “and/or.” The Japanese lore describes replenishing personnel from reinforcement units, while the English says reinforcements are typically held in reserve.

Notes

Title

Card Text

Title

＊戦士の単独行

Card Text

戦士が位置カード上で単独で防衛している場合、戦闘運命数を１回引くことができる。戦士が「タッグ」ならば、戦闘運命数を２回引くことができる。

Lore

''帝国軍の戦士たちは、通常は分隊単位で行動しているが、全員が近接戦闘の訓練を受けており、追い詰められれば果敢な戦いぶりを示す。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' A warrior's solitary action. '''Card text:''' If a warrior is defending alone at a location card, you may draw battle destiny once. If the warrior is Tagge, you may draw battle destiny twice. '''Lore:''' Imperial warriors usually operate in squads, but all are trained in close combat and fight resolutely when cornered. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a location card and drawing battle destiny; the English specifies a site and adding battle destiny.

Title

Card Text

どちらかを選ぶ。１：１フォース消費して、相手のユーズド・デッキを見て、ドロイドがあればすべてロスト・デッキに移動させることができる。２：配備コストと同じだけのフォースを消費して、場に出ている任意のドロイドを１体破壊することができる。

Lore

''トルーパー１１２４、デイヴィン・フェルスは、Ｒ２－Ｄ２とＣ－３ＰＯが脱出ポッドから出る時に落とした部品を発見した。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' It's a droid! '''Card text:''' Choose one. (1) Use 1 Force to look through the opponent's Used Deck; if there are droids, you may move all of them to the Lost Deck. (2) Use Force equal to its deploy cost to destroy any one droid in play. '''Lore:''' Trooper 1124, Davin Felth, discovered a part dropped by R2-D2 and C-3PO as they left their escape pod. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says all droids found may be moved, while the English says any droids found may be moved. The Japanese lore calls the object a part; the English identifies it as droid plating.

Title

ダーク・ジェダイ・ライトセーバー

Card Text

Ｘフォース消費して、戦士キャラクターに配備する（Ｘ＝７－戦士の能力値である）。使い方は、以下の２通り。１：ライトセーバーのある位置でのフォース消耗を＋１する。２：Ｘフォース消費して、キャラクターに対して起動する。運命数を２枚引く。運命数＞能力値ならば命中する。

Lore

''多面体の結晶石が光を収束し、切断力を持たせる。長さ１メートルのエネルギー・ビームを発生。ライトセーバーは、ジェダイの騎士が修行の一環として、自分専用のものを作り出す。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Dark Jedi Lightsaber. '''Card text:''' Use X Force to deploy on a warrior character, where X is 7 minus the warrior's ability. It can be used in two ways: (1) Add 1 to the Force drain at the lightsaber's location. (2) Use X Force to fire it at a character. Draw two destiny. The character is hit if destiny is greater than ability. '''Lore:''' Multifaceted crystals focus light to give it cutting power. It produces an energy beam one meter long. A Jedi Knight makes a personal lightsaber as part of training. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese specifies the lightsaber's location for the Force drain; the English says where present. After instructing the player to draw two destiny, the Japanese compares “destiny” with ability, while the English specifies “total destiny.”

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=89s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 1:29. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. Title

ハン・シーカー

Card Text

１フォース消費して、相手側に配備する。ただし、未踏査の位置カードに限る。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同様にフォースを消費して移動させることができる。ハン・ソロまたは能力値＜３のエイリアンと同じロケーションについたら、そのうち１枚を選んで、ロストさせる。ハン・シーカーもロストする。

Lore

''軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることもできる。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Han Seeker. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on the opponent's side, limited to an unexplored location card. During your control phase, it may move like a character by using Force. When it reaches the same location as Han Solo or an alien with ability less than 3, choose one of them to be lost. Han Seeker is also lost. '''Lore:''' A military remote programmed to track specified individuals or targets meeting specified conditions. Heat and optical sensors track targets with great accuracy. It can also be smuggled aboard a starship. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese describes an unexplored location card for deployment, while the English specifies an unoccupied site. The Japanese names Han Solo; the English says Han. The English explicitly says the chosen target is immediately lost, while the Japanese does not specify immediately.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Han Seeker]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=192s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261106164955/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE Internet Archive watch page]. Title

オーバーロード

Card Text

任意の武器（ガッフィの杖やイウォークの武器を除く）を１つ対象に選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＜その武器の運命数なら、その武器はロストする。運命数＝０なら、武器を保持しているキャラクターや宇宙船も同時にロストする。

Lore

''ライトセーバー、ターボレーザー、ブラスターといった武器は強力なエネルギーセルやジェネレーターで作動する。時にはセルがオーバーヒートして、武器ごと爆発することもある。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Overload. '''Card text:''' Choose any one weapon except a [[Gaderffii Stick]] or an Ewok weapon as the target. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than that weapon's destiny, the weapon is lost. If destiny is 0, the character or starship carrying the weapon is also lost at the same time.[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Overload-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. '''Lore:''' Weapons such as lightsabers, turbolasers and blasters operate using powerful energy cells or generators. Sometimes a cell overheats and explodes together with the weapon.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Overload]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

Sources

次のうちどちらかを選ぶ。１：任意の反乱軍の兵員／トルーパー１名を即座にロストさせる。２：ダーク・ジェダイを参加させた戦闘に勝った直後に使う。１フォース消費して、戦闘に参加した相手のキャラクターを１名選ぶ。運命数を引き、運命数＞対象の能力値なら、対象はロストする。

Lore

''ダース・ベイダーは、尋問の際、少々物理的な手段を取ることもある。タンティヴィIVのアンティリズ艦長は、デス・スターの設計図のありかを吐くよりも、死を選んだ。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Strangulation. '''Card text:''' Choose one of the following. 1: Immediately cause any one Rebel trooper to be lost. 2: Use immediately after winning a battle in which a [[Dark Jedi]] participated. Use 1 Force and choose one opposing character that participated in the battle. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the target's ability, the target is lost.[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Physical-Choke-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. '''Lore:''' Darth Vader sometimes uses somewhat physical methods during interrogation. Captain Antilles of the Tantive IV chose death rather than reveal the whereabouts of the Death Star plans.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Physical Choke]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

Sources

* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 99 (Japanese Premiere checklist, side, type and rarity). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

反応炉制御盤

Card Text

１フォース消費して、場の自分の側に配備する。自分の支配フェイズに、手札の中からカードを好きな枚数だけ選び、自分のユーズド・デッキの一番上にもどすことができる。

Lore

''デス・スターには主反応炉から分岐した制御盤がいくつもあり、巨大なスペース・ステーションの動力供給を制御している。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Reactor control panel. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on your side of the table. During your control phase, you may choose as many cards as you like from your hand and return them to the top of your Used Pile. '''Lore:''' The Death Star has many control panels branching off from the main reactor, controlling the power supply of the immense space station. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese spells out choosing any desired number of cards from the hand; the English says any cards from your hand. Both specify a cost of 1 Force to deploy, the control phase, and the top of the Used Pile. The Japanese title and lore call the terminal a control panel.[ Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 5:50.

Sources

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].
